selector.rationale: The presence of round, hypopigmented macules symmetrically distributed on the face and neck, along with the absence of hair growth in the affected areas, supports the diagnosis of Nevus depigmentosus. The histopathologic findings do not strongly support other options.

rejected.label: Eccrine poroma
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence for eccrine poroma in the vignette

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Histopathologic findings do not support basal cell carcinoma

rejected.label: Tuberous sclerosis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation does not match tuberous sclerosis

rejected.label: Tumors of the follicular infundibulum (TFI)
rejected.why: Although considered, Nevus depigmentosus better explains the clinical findings
